title: ICAB C5 - Principles of Taxation
summary: Comprehensive coverage of Bangladesh Income Tax Act 2023, individual tax computation, company tax, TDS, tax accounting, and Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty Act 2012.

all.name: Full Syllabus Tracker
all.blurb: Official 2025 Syllabus chapter and topic tracker for Principles of Taxation. Track your study progress across all syllabus areas.

stages.title: Area 1: Income Tax Principles & Administration
stages.name: Area 1: Income Tax Principles & Administration
stages.description: Income Tax Act 2023 framework, residential status, scope of income, NBR organization.

nodes.name: Income Tax Act 2023 Framework & Residential Status
nodes.description: Objective of taxation, tax incidence, shifting; National Board of Revenue (NBR) structure; assessment year vs income year; definition of resident and non-resident individuals; scope of total income based on residence.
topics: Constitutional basis and objectives of taxation in Bangladesh
Income Tax Act 2023 structure, definitions, and key concepts
National Board of Revenue (NBR), Taxes Appellate Tribunal, and tax authorities
Income Year vs Assessment Year distinctions
Residential status test for individuals (182-day rule and 90+365 day rule)
Residential status of companies, firms, and associations of persons (AOP)
Scope of income: Worldwide income vs Bangladesh-source income
learningOutcomes: Determine the residential status of individual and corporate taxpayers.
Identify total taxable income scope based on residential status.
Explain the administrative structure and powers of the NBR.
checklists: Memorize assessment year vs income year timelines under ITA 2023
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 2: Computation of Income Tax (Individuals & Companies)
stages.name: Area 2: Computation of Income Tax (Individuals & Companies)
stages.description: Heads of income: Salary, Rent, Business, Capital Gains, Financial Assets, and tax calculation.

nodes.name: Heads of Income & Individual Tax Computation
nodes.description: Income from employment (Section 32/33); Income from rent; Income from business; Capital gains; Income from financial assets; allowable deductions; personal income tax slabs, rebates, and surcharge.
topics: Income from employment: Basic salary, allowances, perquisites, exemptions (1/3rd or Tk 450,000)
Income from house property: Annual value calculation, allowable repairs and maintenance deductions
Income from agricultural property and other sources
Capital gains computation: Realization, exemptions, and tax rates
Investment tax rebate under Section 78: Eligible investments and rebate rate calculation
Individual tax rate slabs, minimum tax based on city corporation location, and wealth surcharge
learningOutcomes: Calculate net taxable income under each statutory head of income.
Determine gross tax liability, investment tax rebates, and net tax payable for individuals.
Compute wealth surcharge based on net wealth thresholds.
checklists: Solve 4 comprehensive individual income tax calculation questions
Review allowable perquisites and salary exemptions under ITA 2023
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

nodes.name: Company Tax Computation & Allowable Deductions
nodes.description: Computation of business income for companies; allowable business expenses (Section 49-55); disallowances (Section 55); tax depreciation vs accounting depreciation; corporate tax rates.
topics: Business profit computation starting from accounting net profit
Allowable business deductions: Rent, repairs, insurance, employee benefits
Inadmissible deductions (Section 55): Unapproved gratuity, cash payments over limits, CSR without proof
Tax depreciation rules: Normal depreciation, initial depreciation, amortisation
Loss set-off and carry-forward rules (up to 6 consecutive years)
Corporate tax rates: Listed vs non-listed companies, banks, tobacco, mobile operators
Minimum tax on gross receipts under Section 163
learningOutcomes: Reconcile accounting profit to taxable business income for companies.
Compute tax depreciation schedules under Third Schedule.
Calculate corporate tax liability including minimum tax rules.
checklists: Practice 3 full corporate tax reconciliation adjustments
Memorize corporate tax rate matrix for listed vs non-listed entities
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 3: TDS, Assessment, Filing & Tax Accounting
stages.name: Area 3: TDS, Assessment, Filing & Tax Accounting
stages.description: Tax Deducted at Source (TDS), advance tax, return submission, assessment, and deferred tax basics.

nodes.name: TDS, Advance Tax, Assessment & Tax Return
nodes.description: Key TDS sections (supply of goods, services, commission, dividends, interest); advance tax payment installments; Tax Day and mandatory return filing requirements; universal self-assessment; tax accounting (IAS 12 basics).
topics: TDS mechanism: Deducting authority obligations, deposit timelines, monthly returns
Key TDS rates: Contractors (Sec 89), Rent (Sec 109), Professional fees (Sec 102), Dividends
Advance tax calculation: 4 equal quarterly installments and interest for short payment
Mandatory requirement to submit return of income (PSR - Proof of Submission of Return)
Tax Day rules, universal self-assessment (Sec 180), and audit selection criteria
Tax accounting overview: Current tax liability vs deferred tax concept (IAS 12 introductory)
learningOutcomes: Apply TDS rates to various commercial transactions.
Calculate quarterly advance income tax obligations.
Explain return submission procedures and consequences of non-compliance.
checklists: Memorize top 10 TDS rates and section numbers
Review Proof of Submission of Return (PSR) mandatory services list
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 4: Value Added Tax (VAT) & Supplementary Duty
stages.name: Area 4: Value Added Tax (VAT) & Supplementary Duty
stages.description: VAT and SD Act 2012, registration, input tax credit, VAT withholding (VDS), and return filing.

nodes.name: VAT Mechanism, Registration & Standard Rate
nodes.description: Fundamentals of VAT; VAT and SD Act 2012; taxable goods and services; Business Identification Number (BIN) registration; turnover tax vs standard VAT; standard rate (15%) and truncated rates.
topics: Basic concept of VAT as a multi-stage consumption tax
Taxable supplies, exempt supplies, zero-rated exports
Mandatory VAT registration thresholds and turnover tax regime
Application and issuance of 9-digit Business Identification Number (BIN)
Standard VAT rate (15%), reduced rates (5%, 7.5%, 10%), and specific VAT rates
Supplementary Duty (SD): Imposition, valuation, and calculation on luxury/sin goods
learningOutcomes: Determine VAT registration liability and obtain BIN.
Calculate Output VAT and Supplementary Duty on commercial transactions.
Distinguish exempt, zero-rated, standard-rated, and truncated supplies.
checklists: Practice Output VAT calculations with and without Supplementary Duty
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

nodes.name: Input Tax Credit, VDS & Monthly VAT Return
nodes.description: Input tax credit (rebate) conditions; VAT Deduction at Source (VDS); mandatory VAT records (Mushak 6.3, 6.5, 6.10); monthly VAT return (Mushak 9.1).
topics: Conditions for claiming Input Tax Credit (Mushak 6.3 invoice, banking channel, 4-tax periods)
Non-creditable input taxes (vehicles, food, gifts, personal consumption)
VAT Deduction at Source (VDS): Withholding entities, applicable services, certificate (Mushak 6.6)
Mandatory VAT books: Purchase register (Mushak 6.1), Sales register (Mushak 6.2), Tax invoice (Mushak 6.3)
Monthly VAT return submission (Mushak 9.1): Due date (15th of following month), structure, adjustments
Penalties, late interest, and offenses under VAT and SD Act 2012
learningOutcomes: Assess admissibility of input tax credit claims.
Apply VDS deductions and issue Mushak 6.6 certificates.
Prepare and file monthly Mushak 9.1 VAT return.
checklists: Complete a mock Mushak 9.1 VAT return with input rebate adjustments
Memorize VDS withholding service list and invoice validation rules
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)
